# Kuyfi MCP

> A remote MCP server that lets your AI agent (Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code) scan and stress-test deployed Soroban smart contracts on Stellar Testnet. Nothing to install: add the server URL to your agent and sign in with GitHub the first time you connect.

MCP endpoint (streamable HTTP): https://kuyfi-mcp.alexbnjmnch.workers.dev/mcp

Add it from Claude Code:

    claude mcp add --transport http kuyfi https://kuyfi-mcp.alexbnjmnch.workers.dev/mcp

## Tools

- list_functions: lists a contract's functions with their input and output types.
- scan_contract: returns the contract's attack surface (functions, types) and saves a report for 24 hours.
- get_report: retrieves a report you created earlier; reports are private to the user who created them.
- fuzz_contract: generates attack vectors and runs them in simulation only (mode=simulate, up to 50 vectors, 20 runs per hour per user).

## Limits

- Stellar Testnet only. There is no mainnet support.
- Simulation only: the server never signs or sends transactions and never handles keys.
- Simulation does not evaluate authorization, so access-control vectors are reported as not evaluated.
- Zero findings is not proof of security. Results are hypotheses and observations, not a replacement for a manual audit.
